name: smwsprites-wart
title: Wart
description:
A recreation of Wart, the final boss from Super Mario Bros. 2.

Wart is a giant toad which will walk back and forth. He will occasionally open his mouth and shoot bubbles. A machine next to him spawns veggies, which can be picked up and thrown into Wart's open mouth to damage him. After 6 hits, the boss dies while slowly falling down. After dying, a door is created.

Read the included readme for instructions on inserting the boss.

Demonstration video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n5BxhjUIEMA
